subject: Matemática
description_pt: Descrever um padrão (ou regularidade) de sequências repetitivas e de sequências recursivas, por meio de palavras, símbolos ou desenhos.

components.description_pt: Identificar a unidade que se repete em uma sequência repetida de objetos, figuras ou números
components.description_en: Identify the repeating unit in a repeating sequence of objects, figures, or numbers
components.cc_component_description: Identify a repeating pattern or rule in a sequence of mathematical operations

components.description_pt: Identificar a regra de crescimento em uma sequência recursiva de objetos, figuras ou números
components.description_en: Identify the rule of growth in a recursive sequence of objects, figures, or numbers
components.cc_component_description: Identify features of a pattern that are not explicit in the rule of the pattern

components.description_pt: Descrever o padrão de uma sequência repetida ou recursiva usando palavras ou desenhos
components.description_en: Describe the pattern of a repeating or recursive sequence using words or drawings
components.cc_component_description: Identify a repeating calculation pattern and describe the rule it suggests

components.description_pt: Representar o padrão de uma sequência usando símbolos ou notação algébrica informal
components.description_en: Represent the pattern of a sequence using symbols or informal algebraic notation
components.cc_component_description: Express regularity in a pattern of results as an algebraic generalization

cc_matches.description: Look for and express regularity in repeated reasoning.

Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule. Identify apparent features of the pattern that were not explicit in the rule itself. *For example, given the rule "Add 3" and the starting number 1, generate terms in the resulting sequence and observe that the terms appear to alternate between odd and even numbers. Explain informally why the numbers will continue to alternate in this way.*
